name: Route Unavailable
description: Explains that an explicit Project, Workspace, or Tab route no longer resolves without silently choosing a different destination.

states: Inspect the retained unavailable address with concise explanatory copy in English and Simplified Chinese.

useWhen: A deep link explicitly identifies a Project, Workspace, or Tab that no longer exists.
avoidWhen: A route is merely incomplete and can be canonicalized to its first ordered descendant.
The application has not completed authentication or runtime initialization and owns a different recovery state.
invariants: The current address is retained so the stale identifier remains observable and shareable for diagnosis.
The surface never silently activates a different Project, Workspace, or Tab.
All user-facing copy is provided by the Orchbee localization catalog.
